feature1.prompt: In the current Django implementation, serialization of many-to-many relationships fails when a custom manager uses select_related. In the Python serializer, this results in a FieldError stating that a field cannot be both deferred and traversed using select_related at the same time. The issue arises because the queryset used for m2m fields is processed with only('pk') without first applying select_related, leading to deferred fields that cannot be traversed. After the fix, the Python serializer should correctly chain select_related() before only('pk') in order to retrieve related objects without error, ensuring that objects with m2m fields are properly serialized.
feature1.hint_texts: Focus on the Python serializer by updating the function that iterates over many-to-many fields. Modify the queryset_iterator function in django/core/serializers/python.py so that it applies select_related() before calling only('pk'). This change should preserve the intended performance optimizations while eliminating the FieldError. Check how natural keys and deferred field handling currently operate in the file to maintain compatibility.

feature2.prompt: The XML serializer in Django is currently unable to serialize many-to-many relationships correctly when a custom manager using select_related is involved. This leads to a FieldError that states a field cannot be both deferred and traversed using select_related at the same time. The problem occurs because the XML serializer applies only('pk') to the m2m field without first using select_related, resulting in a conflict when retrieving related objects. With the fix applied, the XML serializer should apply select_related() prior to only('pk') within its queryset_iterator function, thereby ensuring that m2m fields are accurately handled and serialized into XML without error.
feature2.hint_texts: Concentrate on the XML serializer by updating its m2m field iterator function. In django/core/serializers/xml_serializer.py, the queryset_iterator function needs to be modified to call select_related() before only('pk'). This update should mirror the changes in the Python serializer to avoid deferred field errors. Review how the XML output is constructed to ensure that the change integrates seamlessly with existing XML serialization logic.
